import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

class SupportResistanceStrategy:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.cci_period = 14
        self.ma_short_period = 20
        self.ma_long_period = 50
        self.stochastic_period = 14
        self.williams_r_period = 14
        self.support_level = None
        self.resistance_level = None

    def calculate_indicators(self):
        self.data['CCI'] = self.calculate_cci(self.data['Close'], self.cci_period)
        self.data['MA_Short'] = self.data['Close'].rolling(window=self.ma_short_period).mean()
        self.data['MA_Long'] = self.data['Close'].rolling(window=self.ma_long_period).mean()
        self.data['Stochastic_%K'] = self.calculate_stochastic(self.data['High'], self.data['Low'], self.data['Close'], self.stochastic_period)
        self.data['Stochastic_%D'] = self.data['Stochastic_%K'].rolling(window=3).mean()
        self.data['Williams_%R'] = self.calculate_williams_r(self.data['High'], self.data['Low'], self.data['Close'], self.williams_r_period)

    def calculate_cci(self, close, period):
        tp = (close + (close.shift(1) + close.shift(-1)) / 2) / 3
        cci = (tp - tp.rolling(window=period).mean()) / (tp.rolling(window=period).std() * 0.015)
        return cci

    def calculate_stochastic(self, high, low, close, period):
        ll = low.rolling(window=period).min()
        hh = high.rolling(window=period).max()
        k = ((close - ll) / (hh - ll)) * 100
        return k

    def calculate_williams_r(self, high, low, close, period):
        hh = high.rolling(window=period).max()
        ll = low.rolling(window=period).min()
        r = -100 * ((hh - close) / (hh - ll))
        return r

    def identify_support_resistance(self):
        # Simple implementation, may need to be adjusted based on actual data
        self.support_level = self.data['Low'].rolling(window=20).min()
        self.resistance_level = self.data['High'].rolling(window=20).max()

    def generate_signals(self):
        signals = pd.DataFrame(index=self.data.index)
        signals['long'] = False
        signals['short'] = False

        signals.loc[(self.data['CCI'] > -100) & (self.data['Stochastic_%K'] > self.data['Stochastic_%D']) & (self.data['Williams_%R'] > -80) & (self.data['Close'] < self.support_level), 'long'] = True
        signals.loc[(self.data['CCI'] < 100) & (self.data['Stochastic_%K'] < self.data['Stochastic_%D']) & (self.data['Williams_%R'] < -20) & (self.data['Close'] > self.resistance_level), 'short'] = True

        return signals

    def execute_strategy(self):
        self.calculate_indicators()
        self.identify_support_resistance()
        signals = self.generate_signals()

        # Execute trades based on signals
        trades = pd.DataFrame(index=self.data.index)
        trades['position'] = 0

        for i in range(1, len(self.data)):
            if signals.iloc[i]['long']:
                trades.iloc[i, 0] = 1
            elif signals.iloc[i]['short']:
                trades.iloc[i, 0] = -1
            else:
                trades.iloc[i, 0] = trades.iloc[i-1, 0]

        # Calculate P/L
        trades['p/l'] = trades['position'] * self.data['Close'].pct_change()

        return trades

# Example usage
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
strategy = SupportResistanceStrategy(data)
trades = strategy.execute_strategy()
print(trades)
"
